resumption.policy: Root AGENTS is unchanged and remains the only scoped or override guidance; no parallel active mandate, publication obligation or new work ledger.

implementation.invariant: Each evaluator admits raw values into private preparation-bound checked values. Local, call and intrinsic eligibility reads a construction-controlled root classification without visiting admitted descendants; affine ownership boundaries and arbitrary raw ingress remain checked.
implementation.representation: Containment disallows affine descendants in ordinary aggregates. A private root proof is therefore sufficient for ordinary projections and immutable sharing, while an affine nominal payload inherits its canonical case classification. No subtree proof cache is allocated or serialized.
implementation.independence: Production derives nominal affinity from strictly prepared layouts. The canonical evaluator separately reconstructs accepted owners and its NormalizedReferenceSchema, and owns separate admission, constructors, propagation, type instantiation and eligibility logic. A bounded test-only structural oracle ignores cached classifications.

baseline.admission_observations: Unavailable in the predecessor because it had no checked admission boundary; null is retained rather than fabricated zero.

candidate.binding_note: The measured Rust and generated inputs became implementation commit 6b36c505; only performance and rationale documentation was assembled after this copied candidate. The authoritative full and target receipts separately bind the clean implementation commit.

cost_oracle.W_units: Sum of input-admission nodes, raw-result-admission nodes, immediate constructor-child visits and internal-guard descendant visits, separately in each tier.
cost_oracle.observed: In each candidate matrix W=N+2 for all K. Both internal descendant counters are zero; each tier's root decisions depend on K and invocation form, not N.

forced_rescan.failure: corrupt: internal affinity guard rescanned descendants
forced_rescan.arithmetic: All nine direct forwarding runs return independently expected N before the unchanged acceptance validator rejects actual descendant visits.

cost_oracle.equivalent_path_faults: First-party cost-oracle tests independently restore production or reference guard work and equivalent raw-result work proportional to N*K, and suppress input observations. The real matrix validator rejects each mutant; arithmetic remains N.

performance.sample_policy: One warm-up followed by three measured release-mode folds at each of 256, 1024 and 4096 input items, for both predecessor and candidate. Each invocation has a 120-second wall bound. No timeout occurred; no run was repeated to improve a timing.
performance.units: Wall seconds; sampled process-tree peak RSS bytes; VM instructions / independent reference expressions; cumulative logical allocation bytes and successful nonzero allocation-accounting charges (not global heap allocator events); separate admission, constructor and guard visits.
performance.nonclaims: The decisive proof is the cost matrix and fault sensitivity. Serialization, ordinary collection copying, actual algorithmic work and existing allocation accounting are not claimed eliminated; no universal speedup or allocation reduction is claimed.

reference adapter result failed admission after a possibly visible operation; inspect the outcome before retrying

reference_failure.message: invocation input reference value admission: raw container conceals affine ownership; remove the nested owner before invocation

source_fixtures.coverage: Scalars, nominal/structural records, ordinary/affine variants including empty affine cases, options, lists, internal maps, nested/shared children, rejected ordinary-clone assertions, foreign program/layout/callback identity, malformed raw host and adapter results, direct ownership scope/interface/requirement/generation/use checks, exact borrow/final consume and post-failure reuse.

admission_bounds.byte_one_over: One byte below the measured exact-fit allocation allowance rejects.

source_fixtures.oracle: The separate test-only structural/type walker derives nominal cases from canonical layouts and ignores cached classes. Production class corruption is accepted by the deliberately damaged VM but rejected by the independent reference and oracle.
source_fixtures.artifact_compatibility: The retained unchanged pre-campaign standard artifact is strictly prepared and executes folds at 256, 4096 and 8192 without conversion; both tiers stay within eight frames and zero guard descendants.

bounded_subprocess.operand_note: Only the VM owns an operand stack; the canonical reference's independent continuation/local model is retained.

standalone_http.trap: integer overflow inside the final fold callback after staging

failure.message: execution was cancelled by its owning task scope

containment.raw_adapter_visibility: Injected adapters record one prior effect, reject their malformed result with possible_visibility, invoke no downstream capability and release owned local state. Healthy reuse makes the expected two calls. Reference adapter fixtures are independent isolated test doubles; public effects execute only in production.

limits.notes: Existing narrower decoder/adapter limits and independent reference work units are retained. New metadata is charged without refunds; counters are observations, not fuel or permission. Builds and existing target tooling are outside the acceptance file/time measurement.

maintained.unchanged: Standard/lkjournal semantic HEADs, owners, exact dependencies, routes/ports, stored graph/compiler-unit/bytecode/package/artifact encodings, generated artifact and transport bytes, and deployment/queue/object schemas. No user project migration.

full_implementation.profile_coverage: All product and service gates are members of this fresh full profile. Separate duplicate profile runs are not claimed.

finding.source_inspection: Both VM local/call guards and reference local/call guards still recursively inspect raw immutable values for affine resources. The VM also inspects nominal cases during local affinity classification.
finding.dynamic_evidence: No instrumented candidate was built, so descendant counts, forwarding matrix results and fold samples were not collected. Source inspection is not the required empirical baseline.
finding.invariant_gained: None. Production checked values and the removal of repeated scans have not been implemented.

blocker.boundary: Required release-mode empirical baseline; consequently no candidate for CVA-1 through CVA-6
blocker.reason: Two builds of the isolated measurement-only baseline ended with Cargo exit 101 and rustc SIGKILL. The serial retry ran under the unchanged release profile and increased the cgroup OOM-kill count from 1 to 2.
blocker.diagnostic_limits: The kernel journal query yielded no matching records. The failure diagnosis binds compiler termination plus retained cgroup memory events, including the serial retry's increment; it is not a sampled compiler peak or a measured minimum build-memory requirement.
blocker.tooling_iterations: An unavailable /usr/bin/time wrapper exited 127 before Cargo, and a shell time syntax attempt did not execute Cargo. Both preceded the actual serial retry and are not additional builds or measurements.
blocker.resumption: Provide a workspace with enough memory for the unchanged locked release build, rerun the retained baseline instrumentation and mandatory measurements, then resume implementation and all CVA obligations. The minimum sufficient memory was not measured.
blocker.secondary_prerequisite: The Rust musl target is installed, but musl, musl-dev and musl-tools native packages are absent. Their exact installation inputs are owned by lkjscript-dev release target; installation and target admission were not run.
blocker.stop_authority: Campaign sections 1, 5 and 6 require the empirical baseline, prohibit weakening mandatory proof, and direct stopping after bounded meaningful diagnosis when required proof is unavailable.

target_implementation.scope: Exact copied candidate inspection and execution, with network-disabled named userlands and isolated loopback application fixtures. These are local target-admission observations, not publication, deployment or general Linux portability.

CVA-1.result: Copied discovery/new/plan/apply/inspect/check/build/run succeeds for runtime lists 0,1,256,1024,4096,8192 with independent sums, including 8390656 and 33558528. Ordered/reversed folds return 5/-5. Both tiers stay within eight frames; complete accepted inventories survive reads, plans, execution and stale-apply rejection. Maintained graph-owned header reducer passes.

CVA-2.result: Both direct and transported named-generic nine-pair matrices return N, have input work N+2 independent of K, zero internal descendants and root decisions independent of N at fixed K. The additive W equation holds; actual restored scans and equivalent-path faults fail acceptance.

CVA-3.result: Independent structural/canonical classifications and negative boundary fixtures pass. Raw last-element affine handles/empty variants, foreign identities and malformed results reject before callbacks/downstream effects. Deliberate production class corruption is caught independently. Inherited borrow/consume/scope/generation/interface/requirement protections pass.

CVA-4.result: Bounded subprocess admission and tail cancellation, exact-fit/one-over limits, deep raw disposal, cleanup and healthy reuse pass. The standalone HTTP fold commits once; overflow/cancellation roll back staged writes. Invalid raw adapter results report prior visibility honestly and stop subsequent effects. Worker/session/grant/redaction/shutdown gates pass.

CVA-5.result: Current/clean/reviewed incremental and missing/corrupt-cache recovery agree for equal inputs. The retained same-format artifact executes through strict preparation unchanged. Canonical corruption stays corruption; maintained inventories and owned regenerated bytes agree. Both checked-value paths replace raw slot insertion, and the successor oracle detects restored recursive guards and equivalent scans.

CVA-6.result: Clean implementation commit 6b36c505 passed all 26 source-full gates fresh with zero reuse, then exact static-musl build and nine target classifications including copied checked-value cases and both pinned userlands. Source-bound internal fault/admission fixtures remain separate. Final terminal-commit revalidation has its out-of-band owner below.

Their self-referential source/tree/worktree/candidate/receipt identities are recorded only out of band.
